visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video is captured in real-life footage. [People: Face/Hands] A muscular man wearing a white cap, white t-shirt, and grey shorts stands with his back to the camera, positioned on a weight plate on a bench. A woman with long dark hair, wearing a green sports bra and matching leggings, stands facing him with her hands resting on his shoulders. [Objects: Details/State] A black metal power rack is the central equipment. The man's muscles are relaxed initially. [Setting: Background/Lighting] The gym environment is well-lit with bright overhead studio lighting and decorative purple neon rings on the back wall. (2) [People: Face/Hands] The woman leans in and wraps her arms around the man's neck in a close hug. The man reaches up with both hands to grip the high pull-up bar of the power rack. [Objects: Details/State] The pull-up bar is a thick black steel rod. The man's arm muscles begin to tense as he prepares for the movement. [Setting: Background/Lighting] The scene remains consistent in the brightly lit indoor gym. (3) [People: Face/Hands] The man performs several pull-ups, lifting his body weight while the woman hangs onto him, wrapping her legs around his waist and keeping her arms locked around his neck. Both individuals maintain focused expressions. [Objects: Details/State] The weights on the power rack and the gym floor are clearly visible. The man's back and arm muscles exhibit high definition during the contraction. [Setting: Background/Lighting] Bright reflections are visible on the metallic surfaces of the gym equipment.
